ACT XXVI OF 1997
ACT XXVI OF 1997
PAKISTAN RANGERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th July, 1997]
The following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 8th July, 1997, is
hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing; ,
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan
Rangers (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959

Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing; ,
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
2. Amendment of section 3, W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959.‑‑In the Pakistan Rangers
Ordinance, 1959 (XIV of 1959), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance,
in section 3, in subsection (4), for the words "Force shall be
administered by the Director‑General" the words and commas
"Federal Government shall, for administration of the Force, appoint
Director‑General shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of section 4, Ordinance XIV of 1959.‑‑‑In the said
Ordinance, in section 4,‑‑‑
(a) for subsection (1) following
shall be substituted, namely:‑‑‑
"(1) The Federal Government
may appoint as many Director‑Generals and Deputy Director‑Generals
of the Force as it may consider necessary and determine their headquarters,
places of duties and area of jurisdiction. "; and
(b) subsection (2) shall be
omitted.
